articles.title: DLSS 5 leaked and modders are putting Nvidia’s AI effects on everything - The Verge
articles.description: Modders are applying an unofficial version of Nvidia’s DLSS 5 to a bunch of different games after code for the AI upscaling tech appeared in an early-access build of NBA 2K27.
